exchanges: ok so big week coming up, the client team from brightwater is flying in thursday for the quarterly review and i somehow got stuck organizing literally everything including lunch and the airport pickup and the agenda
That's a lot landing on one person. Want to start with whichever piece has the earliest deadline?

probably the airport thing since their flight lands at 8am and nobody wants to deal with that, sergei said he'd do it which is nice of him he offered to take them in his minivan so we dont need a car service
That saves a lot of hassle and money. Make sure he has their flight number so he can track delays.
good call ill send it to him. then lunch which is the annoying part because there are like 9 people and everyone has some restriction
Collect the restrictions first, then pick a place that can handle all of them. Who's on the list?
so from our side its me sergei fatima oluwaseun and mei, and mei has a serious allergy to peanuts like epipen level so i need to be careful
Definitely worth calling the restaurant ahead about that. Cross-contamination is the real worry with severe allergies.

and from brightwater there's their director, a couple analysts, and their project lead who is ALSO called mei which is going to be so confusing at lunch lol mei tanaka. and she cant have shellfish so sushi is out which is a shame
Two Meis at one table will definitely make for some 'which Mei' moments. Ruling out sushi narrows it down, at least.
yeah i was thinking that italian place on king street but i need to check if they do nut free
Italian is usually a safe bet for a mixed group. A quick call should tell you how they handle nuts.
fatima says thats fine as long as we stay under budget which is like nothing, she's so strict about expenses i think its from her consulting days
Former consultants do tend to watch every line item. Under budget plus allergy-safe is a tight brief, but doable.
ok agenda next. oluwaseun is presenting the new brand concepts which ive seen and they're really good honestly the best work he's done
That's a strong way to open the review. Clients usually remember the visuals more than the numbers.
he's been in a great mood lately, he joined some community orchestra and he plays cello now, apparently he practices every night and his neighbours probably hate him
Picking up an instrument as an adult takes real dedication. Sounds like it's good for him, neighbours aside.
lol. then after the brand stuff its the numbers section which mei is doing, our mei i mean
Got it, so your Mei handles the data portion. How are the numbers looking this quarter?
decent actually up 12 percent on engagement but down on conversion which brightwater is going to grill us on for sure
Leading with the engagement gain and having a clear plan for conversion would help. Do you know why conversion dipped?
landing page redesign went live late, thats basically it, it was a dev bottleneck not our fault
That's a clean explanation as long as you can show the fix is in place now. Any early numbers since it launched?
a little, its trending up. ill have mei pull a chart
A trend line since launch would make the argument for you.
ok also fatima wants a little welcome gift for them, she suggested something local, she's really into handmade stuff she does pottery on saturdays so she's always pushing the craft market
Something handmade and local is a nice touch. A small piece from the craft market would fit the budget too.
maybe candles or mugs or something. ill go wednesday
Mugs with something local on them would be practical. Wednesday gives you a buffer if you need to swap something.
ugh just remembered the meeting room projector has been broken for two weeks and facilities keeps ignoring my tickets
That's worth escalating today given the client visit. Maybe ask Fatima to nudge facilities directly.
good idea she scares them lol
Sometimes that's exactly what a ticket needs.
ok update the italian place said they can do a nut free kitchen setup if we give them 48 hours notice so thats booked for thursday 12:30
Perfect, that covers the biggest risk. Did you mention the shellfish restriction too?
yes all sorted. oh and one thing i got wrong earlier, sergei doesnt have the minivan anymore he sold it last month, he drives a truck now with just two seats so we need a second car
Good thing you caught that before Thursday morning. A second driver or a car service for the overflow should do it.
ill ask oluwaseun if he can drive, he has a car i think
Worth asking. If not, a single car service for the second group is still cheaper than two.
honestly im so tired already and its only monday
Prep weeks are draining. Once the logistics are locked in, Thursday will mostly run itself.
i hope so. last quarter the review went 3 hours over
A tight agenda with time boxes might help. You could ask presenters to stick to a set number of minutes.
yeah ill put times on the agenda. fatima will back me up she hates long meetings
Having her support makes it much easier to cut people off politely.
she ran workshops for a living at Deloitte for like ten years so she's ruthless about timing, ive seen her end a meeting mid sentence
That's a useful ally to have in the room. Clients usually appreciate a meeting that ends on time.
true. ok im gonna write up the agenda now and send it round before i forget
Sounds good. Sending it early gives people time to flag anything.
and then im leaving at 5 sharp no matter what
You've earned it. Good luck with the agenda.
